content:
Apple TV today released the first footage of the second season of the German black comedy "Where is Vendita?" and confirmed its return date. Details as follows.

"Where is Vendita?" returns on October 21

"Where is Vendita?" did not generate much reaction when it first aired in 2024, but was quickly hailed as a thoroughly entertaining, mischievous hidden gem on Apple TV.

The series follows the Klatt family, frustrated by the lack of progress in the police investigation, who decide to take matters into their own hands to find their missing daughter.

Nearly two years after the nine-episode first season aired, Apple TV has finally confirmed that the series will return on October 21, and released the first footage of the new season.

Apple TV has also released a synopsis for the second season of "Where is Vendita?", but the content contains spoilers; please finish watching the first season before continuing:

Apple TV costs $12.99 per month, and you can also subscribe via the Apple One bundle. The platform offers a number of hit series and films, including "Severance", "The Big Guy in Hollywood", "The Morning Show", "Siblings' Class" and "The Dropout".
